settings.heading: 4x6 Area Rugs - The Size That Quietly Changes a Room
settings.row_content:
Some rugs shout for attention.
A 4x6 rug doesn’t.

It settles in.
It makes a space feel lived-in, not styled for photos.

This is the rug you place near the door so guests wipe their feet without thinking.
The one you slide beside the bed so mornings start softer.
The rug that fills an empty corner and suddenly the room makes sense.

At Indian Rug Store, our 4x6 area rugs are handmade in Jaipur - by real people, not machines - just like we’ve been doing since 1990. Same city. Same workshops. Many of the same families.

No factories. No imported blanks. No inflated “luxury” labels.

Just good rugs, made properly.

settings.heading: Why 4x6 Rugs Are So Easy to Live With
settings.row_content:
If you’ve ever bought a rug that felt too big or oddly small, you’ll understand why people come back to this size again and again.

A 4x6 carpet fits naturally in places like:

  • Entryways and foyers

  • Beside the bed or under a bench

  • Reading corners and home offices

  • Small living rooms and apartments

It’s big enough to ground a space - but light enough to move when life shifts things around.

And if you’re unsure, our Visualize in Your Room tool helps you see it before it arrives. No guessing. No regret purchases.

settings.heading: What “Handmade in Jaipur” Actually Means Here
settings.row_content:
A lot of websites say this.

Very few mean it.

In Jaipur, we still watch rugs being made the slow way.
Wool washed, spun, and dyed.
Cotton stretched on wooden looms.
Knots tied one by one - sometimes thousands in a single square foot.

If you look closely, you’ll see tiny irregularities.
That’s not a flaw. That’s the signature.

Every Jaipur handmade rug we sell is made in-house. We don’t buy finished rugs from traders. We don’t outsource to unknown units. We know who made your rug - and how long it took.

That’s why they last.

settings.heading: Choosing the Right 4x6 Rug (From People Who Make Them)
settings.row_content:
A few simple thoughts from our workshop floor:

  • Entryways: Flatweaves or washable styles

  • Bedrooms: Wool or cotton - soft under bare feet

  • Modern homes: Subtle patterns, neutral tones

  • Traditional spaces: Hand-knotted or classic designs

And if you’re stuck, ask us. We’d rather help you choose once than see you return something that never felt right.

settings.heading: What size room is a 4x6 rug best for?
settings.row_content: A 4x6 rug fits small to medium spaces  -  entryways, beside beds, reading nooks or small living rooms - and helps define a zone without overwhelming the room.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right rug size?
settings.row_content: Measure your space and leave about 12–18" of floor around the edges. A 4x6 rug should feel balanced under furniture or in a corner without looking too small.

settings.heading: What materials are best for a 4x6 area rug?
settings.row_content: Wool offers durability and warmth, cotton is easy to clean, and flatweave or jute adds casual texture. Choose based on traffic, comfort, and care needs.

settings.heading: Can I put a 4x6 rug under furniture?
settings.row_content: Yes,  in small rooms, place it under a coffee table or chair. In others, use it beside a bed or sofa to soften the space without covering the entire floor.
